author: ThankfulForYou2
title: Don't forget about people with low vision
content:
As someone with a visual impairment, I am very disappointed by the recent update. The new icons are much harder to see than they were before, and the game is no longer as accessible for people with low vision. The previous format was much easier to use, and I don’t understand why there isn’t an option to keep it.
I have contacted customer support multiple times to ask about bringing back the old format or adding it as an accessibility option, but my messages have gone unanswered. Since I haven’t received a response, I have contacted the National Federation of the Blind to make them aware of my concerns.
I really enjoy this game and want to keep playing it, but accessibility matters. Please bring back the previous format as an option or create an accessibility mode so players with visual impairments can continue enjoying the game.

author: Bmorechick 27
title: Going downhill!
content:
I’ve been playing this game for a long time (level 11,300+), so I’ e seen the good, bad and now ugly! It used to be so simple back in the day: great graphics, great rewards, entertaining game. I even paid for ad free which I never do! 

There have been a series of updates that have annoyed me. I used to look forward to the pearl (clam) challenge on Fridays. Since they switched to the “tiered” rewards, I don’t bother to try to accumulate the clams. You now have to use points on rewards you don’t even want just to unlock the next tier. By the time I waste points to get to what I really want, I don’t have enough points to get it! PLEASE remove that “update” and revert back to how it used to be.

The paint challenge is another “update” that is terrible IMO. I used to enjoy designing a space with color palettes THAT I CHOSE. Now I’m just agreeing with predefined palettes that I had no input on. Another challenge I’m no longer excited to participate in.

Last, and I’ll keep it brief because there are already TONS of reviews complaining about the graphics from the latest update. I tried it out a while ago, but hated it so I reverted to the old. I hope they don’t force it because those graphics are too cartoonish and harder to distinguish. Keep the old version.

One suggestion I’d like to make to DEV: allow users to “bank” infinity time. I may be rewarded an hour worth of unlimited time but lose it if I don’t spend the full hour. If I close out with 30 minutes of time remaining, I should still have access to the remaining 30 minutes when I resume playing.

To sum this all up: all updates aren’t good updates! If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Listen to the users!

title: Beware
content:

This new version is much much harder than the first version. Almost making it not fun to play. It should not take 15+ lives to get through one level. To me that’s just ridiculous. They also don’t give pearls like they used to so you can replenish your rewards.
